name: Generate env backgrounds
command:
cd ~/pixel-art-studio && source .venv/bin/activate && \
python generate.py character -p "16-bit pixel art video game battle arena background, dark stone keep at night, flaming torches on the walls, mossy stone floor, moonlight from a high window, atmospheric, no characters, empty scene" -o test/env/arena_arena.png --width 1024 --height 512 --seed 7 && \
python generate.py character -p "16-bit pixel art video game battle background, dark forest clearing at night, bioluminescent mushrooms, fireflies, a small campfire in the center, mist, moody purple and teal palette, no characters, empty scene" -o test/env/forest_grove.png --width 1024 --height 512 --seed 42 && \
python generate.py character -p "16-bit pixel art video game battle background, underground cavern arena, purple crystal formations, stalactites, glowing runes on the floor, fog, no characters, empty scene" -o test/env/cavern_depths.png --width 1024 --height 512 --seed 99
